body:
here's a game, and you'll need the site for it.

The Runway is one of the six threads on longlivets.com — twelve eras laid out as twelve wardrobes, from the curls and cowboy boots of debut to the orange-sequin showgirl of her twelfth album. scrub through all of them, end to end.

now find the two eras that wear the same clothes. two records, back to back, that share one closet — the cream cable-knit cardigan, the rust flannel, the muted-autumn everything. she told you they matched herself: she called one the other's "sister record" the day it arrived.

name both in the replies. first one right wins nothing but the quiet satisfaction of knowing.

longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread-fashion

(pictured: The Runway, as it lives on longlivets.com)
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-23 23:00Z IG, thread:fashion:interactive-challenge (The Runway; August's Runway angle per the ledger), hook "the challenge" — name a specific thing to go find and ask for a reply. Answer is folklore + evermore. Source: apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts RUNWAY_LOOKS — look-folklore ("cream cable-knit cardigan with embroidered stars", cottagecore) and look-evermore ("rust plaid and autumnal tones"), whose description states Swift herself called evermore folklore's "sister record" on release; twelve looks run debut ("cowboy boots") through tloas ("orange sequins"). Media: /social/library/thread-fashion-screen.png (mediaKind site-screen — the thread page is a product surface, the one subject that legitimately earns a screenshot per the Taylor-photo standard's rung 2; no committed real photo fits a cross-era wardrobe post, and the calendar block specifies a Runway screenshot). Not in the last 10 posted IG media. Link /?lens=fashion (lens id 'fashion' confirmed). Blocklist-safe (wardrobe/aesthetics). Campaign story-unique and shared only with the 08-25 X fashion sibling (findPostedDuplicate matches platform+campaign).
